title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 10, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: unslothai/unsloth is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: unslothai/unsloth leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: unslothai/unsloth — 9 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 60.3 below its current daily pace, with 2 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 92 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
pydantic/pydantic-ai — No same-day commit after 187 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Watch for a release that brings chosen MCP sources into research
dailyInsight.insight: Unsloth Studio has merged a way to select MCP search tools for Deep Research. Their results can supply labelled evidence to a report alongside the web and knowledge base.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Each search query is also sent to the selected eligible tools. Returned facts enter report synthesis and are saved for resumed work, but remain outside the prompts choosing the next search.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: A team with information behind a compatible search tool gains a path into research reports without first importing the whole corpus into the knowledge base. Connecting a server alone did not give the research mode that access.

actions.audience: Teams evaluating Studio research with custom information sources
actions.label: Wait for a containing release, then trace one known answer
actions.instruction: When an installed version contains PR13103, use a disposable source with a known answer and select only its intended search tool. Check the resulting answer and citation against the source, then repeat with the tool unselected. Inspect remote tool and model-provider routes before using sensitive records.
actions.effort: One bounded comparison after a containing release is available

receipts.title: Deep Research adds selected MCP search sources
receipts.supports: Selected query fan-out, persisted tool excerpts and distinct MCP citation labels in merged source.

receipts.title: Desktop v0.1.905-beta predates the merge
receipts.supports: Latest inspected packaged Desktop release does not contain the new research path.

confidence.basis: Inspected merged source, parent and release ancestry; upstream reports a controlled synthetic trial. One isolated frontend citation test passed locally.

dailyInsight.limitation: No complete live research session was run by this publication. Latest inspected Desktop beta lacks the feature. Tool labels identify a supplier, not verified original documents. Tool facts do not steer subsequent searches; local installation does not imply local-only data processing.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing release that fails to call the selected eligible source or drops its evidence from synthesis would weaken the practical finding. A later implementation feeding its facts into next-action prompts would revise the planner boundary.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing release and reproducible known-answer task that preserves useful underlying evidence, followed by a trial requiring the next query to depend on a newly found fact.

coverage.statement: All 29 included projects and all 13 core coding agents have fresh source receipts for this edition.

attentionQueue.note: At most three projects survive the morning filter. A receipt is required; movement alone is not a story.
